title: POV: payday was Friday and your balance still looks like this
description:
nobody teaches you how to check a paycheck. you see the number and hope it's right.

doubles, staying late, night shifts, overtime, deductions... by the time you add it all up by hand it's 1am.

we built ShiftPayday for exactly this. put in your rate, hours, overtime, night hours and deductions and it shows your take-home with the full breakdown, so you can check it against your stub before the money lands.

the calculator is free, no account needed. Premium ($4.99/mo) adds a shift log, payday countdown and pay history. it's an estimate from the rates you enter, not tax advice.

#shiftwork #nightshift #payday #overtime #paycheck
